afg_quebec_2026.limits: Professional-engineering association fee guidance; not observed average transaction prices and not a firm quote for manufacturing scheduling. Exclude construction signoff or licensed engineering approval from an unqualified automation offering.

illustrative_bounded_package.sensitivity: 0.5x to 2x estimated hours, plus source rate range. Keep CAD and USD separate or state a sourced/as-assumed FX conversion explicitly. This example is not a recommended selling price.

arinti_offer.limits: Broader implementation engagement than a bounded schedule computation. Source explicitly says production readiness depends on constraints and complexity. Posted asking price, not an observed sale or evidence that our product will attract buyers.

bitbros_offer.limits: Broad consulting diagnostic, not a direct same-scope quote. Use only as category evidence. Do not silently call this USD.

commercial_calibration.demand_evidence_status: Existing supplier offerings establish a service category, not demand for AGI Alpha. Conversion, willingness to pay, trust, churn, job arrival rates, customer input effort and cancellation/refund behavior remain assumptions requiring prospective customer validation.
commercial_calibration.residual_human_cost: Record actual residual obligations if measured; otherwise label scenario costs. Do not impose a fixed arbitrary review time as a physical necessity or claim zero residual work as demonstrated.

sources.title: Is Scaling Learned Optimizers Worth It? Evaluating The Value of VeLO’s 4000 TPU Months
sources.author: Fady Rezk, Antreas Antoniou, Henry Gouk and Timothy Hospedales
sources.scope: Independent evaluation found tuning requirements and no general quality/speed advantage for VeLO; motivates independent complete-cost comparison and allowing training to fail.

implementation_implications: Compare learned dispatch/portfolio policies against competent generic solvers under declared equal resources. A heuristic-only Beta proxy is not verified frontier AI competence.
Separate objective quality, validity, latency, model-call costs, CPU time and training costs. A faster scheduler can be worse on tardiness or stability.
Use independently held-out facilities, demand patterns and disruptions. Train on historical schedules only where rights permit; disclose generated data.
A novel adjacent robustness offering still needs independent acceptance and prospective buyer validation. A simulation can show conditional modeled viability only.

No source here supplies this study's conversion rate, willingness-to-pay distribution, training-success probability, retention advantage or residual-human burden. Those must be observed or labeled assumed.
